teaser.en: When the sun sets during Ramadan, many Digo households break the fast the traditional way: with a date.
teaser.sw: Jua linapozama wakati wa Ramadhani, kaya nyingi za Wadigo hufuturu kwa njia ya jadi: kwa tende.
teaser.dg: Dzuwa richitswa wakati wa Ramadhani, mbari nyinji za Adigo nkuvugula kpwa njira ya chimila: kpwa tende.

summary.en: *Mtende*, the date palm, is a feather palm that is only occasionally planted on the coast; most dates are imported. Its fruit, *tende*, holds a special place at the table during Ramadan.
summary.sw: *Mtende* ni mchikichi wenye majani kama manyoya ambao hupandwa mara chache tu pwani; tende nyingi huagizwa kutoka nje. Tunda lake, *tende*, lina nafasi maalum mezani wakati wa Ramadhani.
summary.dg: *Mtende* ni muhi wa aina ya mnazi wenye makodza ga manyoya, unaophandwa mara chache bahi pwani; tende nyinji nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze. Tundare, *tende*, rina nafasi ya chipekee kpwa chakurya wakati wa Ramadhani.

about.en:
*Mtende* is a feather palm with a rough trunk patterned by the bases of old leaves and a crown of stiff, grey-green, feather-shaped fronds. The lower leaflets are hardened into sharp spines.

Male and female flowers grow on separate trees, and only the female trees bear fruit: heavy hanging bunches of dates, the *tende*, which ripen from yellow or red to brown.
about.sw:
*Mtende* ni mchikichi wenye majani kama manyoya, wenye shina gumu lililopambwa na vitako vya majani ya zamani na taji la majani magumu, ya kijani-kijivu, yenye umbo la manyoya. Vijani vya chini vimegeuka kuwa miiba mikali.

Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye miti tofauti, na ni miti ya kike tu inayozaa matunda: vishada vizito vinavyoning'inia vya tende, *tende*, zinazoiva kutoka manjano au nyekundu hadi kahawia.
about.dg:
*Mtende* ni muhi wa aina ya mnazi wenye makodza ga manyoya, wenye kolo ririro na mikpwaruzo ya mlita ya makodza ga kare na chitswa cha makodza mafu ga chijani-ivu-ivu ga umbo ra manyoya. Makodza madide ga photsi ganakala magumu na kukala miya ya ntsa.

Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mihi tafwauti, na ni mihi ya chichetu tu inayovyala matunda: mabunda mazito ga tende, *tende*, zinazoivwa kula rangi ya mandano au kundu hadi rangi ya dongo.

where.en: It is only occasionally planted on the south coast, and the dates sold in local markets are mostly imported. The humid coast suits it less well than the dry lands where dates are grown commercially.
where.sw: Hupandwa mara chache tu katika pwani ya kusini, na tende zinazouzwa katika masoko ya ndani kwa kiasi kikubwa huagizwa kutoka nje. Pwani yenye unyevu haiufai sana kama nchi kavu ambako tende hulimwa kibiashara.
where.dg: Unaphandwa mara chache bahi pwani ya kusini, na tende zinazoguzwa kpwa soko za hipha kpwa unji nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze. Pwani ya mnyevu-mnyevu taifwaha dza tsi kavu ambako tende nkuphandwa kpwa biashara.

uses.en: Dates are eaten especially when breaking the Ramadan fast, at sunset, before the evening meal.
uses.sw: Tende huliwa hasa wakati wa kufuturu katika Ramadhani, jua linapozama, kabla ya mlo wa jioni.
uses.dg: Tende nkuriwa hasa wakati wa kuvugula Ramadhani, dzuwa richitswa, kabla ya chakurya cha dziloni.

culture.en: In a largely Muslim community, *tende* are closely linked to Ramadan, when it is customary to break the day's fast with a date.
culture.sw: Katika jamii ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa ni ya Waislamu, *tende* zimefungamana sana na Ramadhani, ambapo ni desturi kufungua saumu ya mchana kwa tende.
culture.dg: Kpwa jamii ambayo atu anji ni Aislamu, *tende* zinahusiana sana na Ramadhani, wakati ambapho ni desturi kuvugula kpwa tende.

names.en: The Mgombato dictionary gives *mtende* for the date palm, and Pakia records the fruit as *tende*. The Swahili names are the same: *mtende* for the palm and *tende* for the fruit. In English it is the date palm, and its scientific name is *Phoenix dactylifera*.
names.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mtende* kwa mchikichi huu, na Pakia anarekodi tunda kama *tende*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni yaleyale: *mtende* kwa mti na *tende* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *date palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Phoenix dactylifera*.
names.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mtende* kpwa muhi, na Pakia anaandika tunda dza *tende*. Madzina ga Chiswahili ni higa higa: *mtende* kpwa muhi na *tende* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *date palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Phoenix dactylifera*.

reason.en: Same genus: the wild date palm
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga: uchindu, mtende wa weruni
Muhi wanjina wa aina ya mnazi unaomera kanda-kanda ya midzi

reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa aina ya mnazi wenye makodza ga manyoya
